detail.longDescription: I´m developing a program to fill a 9x9 board with values from 1 to 9, and those values shouldn´t repeat in rows or columns. Although the (abstract) way to do it is easy, the program doesn´t work properly. It works fine up to 4 values (1,2,3,4), but it gets into an infinite loop for the rest of the values (5,6,7,8,9). Some rules: The matrix have to end up with all the values 1..9, with no two equal values in a row/column; so a valid column could be (3,5,2,1,9,7,6,4,8), and the rows as well but e.g. the value of cell 0,0 and 1,1 could be the same (since they are in different rows and columns) I checked it several times but can´t find any mistakes. Could you help me solve this? function rh_create_distribution() { console.log() console.log('...rh_create_distribution starts') var distribution_board = [ [], [], [], [], [], [], [], [], [] ] for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) { for (let j = 0; j < 9; j++) distribution_board[i][j] = undefined } function assign_value_to_a_cell(param_possible_cell_value) { var avaliable_columns_for_specific_value = new Set([0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]) for (let row_param = 0; row_param < 9; row_param++) { console.log() console.log('row: ' + row_param) var out_while = 0 while (out_while === 0) { var random_column = [...avaliable_columns_for_specific_value][Math.floor(Math.random() * [...avaliable_columns_for_specific_value].length)]; console.log('column to use: ' + random_column) console.log('checking of cell (' + row_param + ',' + random_column + ')') if (distribution_board[row_param][random_column] === undefined) { console.log('the value has been asigned to the cell...') distribution_board[row_param][random_column] = param_possible_cell_value console.log('cell`s value is: ' + distribution_board[row_param][random_column]) console.log('deleting columns from avaliable_columns_for_specific_value...') avaliable_columns_for_specific_value.delete(random_column) console.log('and the set of avaliable columns is ' + [...avaliable_columns_for_specific_value]) out_while = 1 } // end if } // end while } //end for rows } // end assign_value_to_a_cell for (let possible_cell_value = 1; possible_cell_value < 6; possible_cell_value++) { // se recorren los distintos valores en orden console.log() console.log('working cell value: ' + possible_cell_value) assign_value_to_a_cell(possible_cell_value) } // end for values console.log('...rh_create_distribution ends') } // end rh_create_distribution rh_create_distribution()
